schemaNote: schemaVersion 3 (RENKAN R3-C, P0-4 sweep): every remaining direct saveStore() caller now carries an explicit disposition. The 14 learner-state-mutating callers of schemaVersion 2 were converted to commitStorePatch (copy, validate, persist, then publish — rollback is free because the live roots are never touched before the durability boundary). What remains is UI preference state and the observation debounce flush, each documented at the call site. lineAfterPatch values are a line-pin against the CURRENT corridor.js and are recomputed by verify-corridor-storage-integrity.mjs on every landing.

callers.dispositionNote: The flush persists rows already published to the session ledger; the 1.2s debounce (+ pagehide/visibility flush) is the documented session-ahead-of-durability window for burst-arriving observations. A rollback would DROP evidence; instead a failed save surfaces the storage alert and the rows remain in S.obslog for the next flush or any envelope write to carry.
readerPos is a reading-position bookmark, not learner evidence; a lost write costs one scroll offset.
Same bookmark root as the scroll debounce, written at the exact line being left.
Display dials (kanji/furigana/spacing) are presentation preferences; the session keeps working unpersisted and the alert names any failure.
Same bookmark root, written when the tray opens over an article.

sweepP04.retainedRule: UI reading-position bookmarks and display dials are preferences, not learner evidence; the observation debounce flush persists rows already published to the session ledger and retries on the next flush — failure surfaces the storage alert. Everything that mutates deck, schedule, evidence, capture, lists, lesson, or AI-shelf roots rides commitStorePatch.

directLearnerStoreBypasses.risk: Direct read is outside quarantine and can throw before export feedback.
Direct replacement bypasses candidate construction and performs only weak envelope validation.

claimBoundary: Only deep learner-store read quarantine, exact-byte candidate self-validation, reserved-name-safe record production and round-trip, write-before-publish helper semantics with post-setItem UI isolation, reader finish, entry capture, standard/focus-drill grade, one stable visible storage alert with dynamic sheet description, and article-load retry are closed by the original donor. The R3-C sweep extends the write-before-publish boundary to every learner-state mutating caller listed in sweepP04.convertedSurfaces; the five retained callers are documented dispositions, not open debt.
